browser.about: A fresh Chrome window per worker, for websites. Not signed in to anything at the start

files.about: Read and write files in the shared workspace folder

terminal.about: Runs shell commands and Claude Code (the claude CLI) in Terminal windows of its own, and returns their exact output and exit code. Use it for every command line, coding task, build, test, install or deploy, instead of typing into Terminal with the desktop tools

desktop.about: Drives the user's own Mac apps (Cursor, Claude, Word, Slack, Discord and any other) in the background through accessibility and window screenshots. The apps are already signed in
desktop.setup: To add desktop app control, see "Desktop apps" in the README.
